decks.notes: The key concept of this Jeskai Aggro deck is to quickly deploy aggressive creatures such as Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Ocelot Pride, while also utilizing burn spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment to control the board and deal direct damage to the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Ranger-Captain of Eos and Seasoned Pyromancer to generate card advantage and maintain pressure on the opponent. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Phlage, Titan of Fire?s Fury provide powerful finishers, while cards like Thraben Charm and Mockingbird offer utility and disruption. The mana base is designed to support the deck's aggressive game plan with a mix of lands that provide colored mana sources.

The deck focuses on quickly milling the opponent's deck, using cards like Hedron Crab and Ruin Crab to mill cards with landfall triggers, and cards like Archive Trap and Glimpse the Unthinkable to mill large chunks of cards at once. It also includes disruption and removal spells like Fatal Push and Drown in the Loch to control the game until enough cards are milled to win with cards like Tasha's Hideous Laughter. The deck aims to win by completely decking the opponent and denying them of resources.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Amulet of Vigor to ramp into Primeval Titan quickly and efficiently, allowing for explosive plays and establishing a strong board presence. Utilizing lands such as Simic Growth Chamber and Lotus Field in combination with bounce lands and utility lands like Bojuka Bog and Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle, the deck can quickly assemble the pieces needed for the combo win condition with cards like Scapeshift and Summoner's Pact. The inclusion of Aftermath Analyst and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove provide additional support and versatility to the main strategy.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker. It also utilizes control elements such as Writhing Chrysalis and Kozilek's Return to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck includes cards like Utopia Sprawl and Talisman of Impulse to accelerate mana production, while Ancient Stirrings helps to find key pieces of the deck. Overall, the strategy revolves around ramping up quickly to overwhelm the opponent with massive Eldrazi threats while controlling the board with disruptive spells.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a mix of creatures and burn spells. The key strategy is to play efficient threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer, while using burn spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment to clear the way for attacks. The deck also utilizes static effects like Static Prison to slow down the opponent's game plan, while utilizing powerful anthems like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah to pump up the team for a lethal attack. The deck aims to maintain constant pressure and close out games before the opponent can stabilize.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays while utilizing the Blink mechanic to gain value from entering the battlefield effects of creatures. The deck includes removal spells and hand disruption to control the board while using cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp to repeatedly trigger powerful creature abilities. The deck also includes a mix of powerful creatures with strong enter the battlefield effects to create tempo swings and overwhelm the opponent. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive plays while ensuring consistency in casting spells.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by ramping up mana quickly with cards like Utopia Sprawl and Eldrazi Temple, allowing you to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker. The deck also includes removal spells like Dismember and Kozilek's Command to deal with threats, as well as ramp spells like Sowing Mycospawn and Talisman of Curiosity. Ultimately, the goal is to overwhelm your opponent with big creatures and powerful spells while maintaining control of the game.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive creatures and using powerful spells to deal direct damage to the opponent. The creatures in the deck have high power and toughness, allowing them to quickly pressure the opponent. The deck also includes spells like Lightning Bolt and Tribal Flames to deal additional damage and control the board. Leyline of the Guildpact and Leyline Binding provide additional support and protection for your creatures. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast, efficient creatures and direct damage spells to secure a quick victory.

This aggressive deck focuses on playing efficient creatures like Wild Nacatl and Territorial Kavu to quickly apply pressure on the opponent. It also utilizes powerful spells like Lightning Bolt and Tribal Flames to control the board and finish off the opponent. The deck is further enhanced by Leyline of the Guildpact and Leyline Binding to protect its creatures and disrupt the opponent's game plan. With a solid mana base and a mix of denial spells, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with early aggression and versatile threats.

The deck focuses on aggressive gameplay with a mix of creatures and spells that can quickly deal damage to the opponent. It utilizes a combination of powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury, along with burn spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment to control the board and push for lethal damage. The inclusion of Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Arena of Glory provides additional support for the creatures while Static Prison helps to disrupt the opponent's strategy. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast, efficient aggression.

This deck focuses on aggressive creatures that can be blinked in and out of play to trigger their abilities multiple times. The deck is designed to quickly overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures like Emperor of Bones and Ketramose, the New Dawn. By using cards like Flickerwisp and Ephemerate, the deck can repeatedly exile and return creatures to the battlefield for maximum value. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Fatal Push and Thoughtseize to help control the game. Overall, the key concept is to use blink effects to generate continuous value and pressure the opponent.

The deck focuses on aggressive creatures that can be repeatedly blinked in and out of play to generate value and overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like Flickerwisp and Ephemerate, the deck aims to continuously blink powerful threats like Emperor of Bones and Ketramose, the New Dawn. The deck also includes disruption with cards like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize, as well as graveyard hate with Relic of Progenitus. The mana base is built to support a mix of white, black, and blue sources to ensure smooth casting of the deck's varied spells.

The key concept of this deck is to play aggressively with low-cost creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Monastery Swiftspear, while using spells like Mutagenic Growth and Lightning Bolt to clear the opponent's board. Slickshot Show-Off and Cori-Steel Cutter provide additional damage, while Mishra's Bauble helps to dig for cards. The deck aims to quickly deal damage to the opponent and control the board with cheap spells before finishing them off with a final burst of damage. It relies on explosive plays and careful resource management to overwhelm the opponent.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on swift creatures that can deal quick damage to the opponent while utilizing spells like Lightning Bolt and Mutagenic Growth to finish off the opponent. Mishra's Bauble helps with card selection while cards like Slickshot Show-Off and Cori-Steel Cutter provide versatility in combat. The deck aims to control the board early with efficient creatures and spell removal, paving the way for a quick victory through direct damage and combat. The lands help ensure consistent mana supply for the aggressive strategy.
